description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DSpark verify steps of 1-8 requests x 6 rows over SGLang's FP4 index plane (64-row pages): ragged contexts (the longest is ctx columns, the others between ctx/2 and ctx), scored by one FULL index-source launch with the step's walk plan. Derived from AgentX corpus statistics (decode-step-weighted context, in-flight requests per session); not yet confirmed by a live capture. Steps estimated below or near the 10 us floor (short contexts; one or two requests below 256K) are correctness-only.
